nodes.text: And lest that should perhaps seem to have been passed over which most of all attacks the faith of the catholic religion: that a number of clerics or laymen give themselves to auguries, and under the name of a feigned religion, by what they call the "lots of the saints", profess a science of divination, or promise [to tell] the future by inspecting any writings whatever; whoever, cleric or layman, is detected either consulting or teaching this, let him be held a stranger to the Church.
